# Tre Coleman Consulting

> Restaurant operations consulting for independent operators: restaurants, catering
> companies, food trucks, and ghost kitchens. Tre Coleman finds and fixes profit leaks
> in labor scheduling, menu pricing, food cost, and daily systems. Based in Louisa,
> Virginia; works on site across Central Virginia and remotely nationwide. Engagements
> run from a $350 Profit Leak Snapshot to $2,000/month fractional COO advisory.


## Start here

- [Restaurant Operations Consultant in Virginia](https://trecoleman.com/): Independent restaurant, food truck, and catering operators: find and fix the profit leaks in labor, menu, and systems. Virginia-based, working nationwide.
- [Restaurant Profit Leak Snapshot | 90-Minute Diagnostic](https://trecoleman.com/profit-leak-snapshot.html): A 90-minute session on your P&L, labor, and item mix. Leave with your top 3 profit leaks priced in dollars and a prioritized fix list. $350.
- [Contact a Restaurant Operations Consultant](https://trecoleman.com/contact.html): Tell me where your operation is bottlenecked and get a practical first step. Book a $350 Profit Leak Snapshot or send a note about your operation.
- [About Tre Coleman | Restaurant Operations Consultant](https://trecoleman.com/about.html): 10+ years running multi-unit restaurant, catering, and food truck operations. Operator-first consulting for owners who need systems, not slide decks.

## Services

- [Restaurant & Food Service Consulting Services](https://trecoleman.com/services.html): AI workflows, SOPs and training, menu engineering, local marketing, and fractional ops support for independent restaurant and catering operators.
- [Fractional COO for Restaurants & Food Trucks](https://trecoleman.com/advisory.html): Weekly strategy calls, KPI reviews, and on-call operator support for $1M+ restaurant and catering operations. $2,000/mo, no long-term contract.
- [Menu Engineering for Independent Restaurants](https://trecoleman.com/menu-engineering.html): Contribution margin analysis, menu redesign, and server training that shift your mix toward high-profit items without across-the-board price hikes.
- [Restaurant SOPs & Staff Training Systems](https://trecoleman.com/sops-training.html): Role scorecards, opening and closing checklists, and 30-60-90 onboarding plans that end tribal knowledge and shorten new-hire ramp time.
- [Local Store Marketing for Restaurants](https://trecoleman.com/lsm.html): 12-week local marketing calendars, community partnerships, and trackable offers that fill slow shifts for restaurants and food trucks.
- [AI Automation for Restaurant Operations](https://trecoleman.com/ai-integration.html): Cut manager admin time with practical AI workflows for scheduling, prep, reporting, and training. Built by an operator, rolled out without floor disruption.
- [Food Truck Consulting & Profitability](https://trecoleman.com/food-truck-consulting.html): Event pricing, prep systems, and staffing for food truck operators who are busy but not profitable. Remote nationwide, in person across Virginia.
- [Catering Business Consulting & Pricing](https://trecoleman.com/catering-consulting.html): Full-cost pricing, labor allocation, and contract margin work for catering operations growing in revenue but not in profit. Remote nationwide.
- [Restaurant Consulting in Virginia](https://trecoleman.com/virginia-restaurant-consulting.html): Restaurant, food truck, and catering consulting based in Louisa, Virginia. In-person across Central Virginia, remote nationwide.

## Writing

- [Restaurant Operations Insights & Playbooks](https://trecoleman.com/blog.html): Practical operations, profitability, and marketing playbooks for independent restaurant, food truck, and catering operators. No theory, just systems.
- [Why Your Restaurant Is Busy But Not Profitable](https://trecoleman.com/blog/busy-but-not-profitable.html): Full dining room, flat bank balance. The four places independent restaurants lose margin while volume looks healthy, and how to tell which one is yours.
- [What a Fractional COO Does for Restaurants](https://trecoleman.com/blog/fractional-coo-for-restaurants.html): What a fractional COO actually handles week to week, when an operation is ready for one, and how it compares to a full-time hire on cost.
- [Fractional COO vs Restaurant Consultant](https://trecoleman.com/blog/fractional-coo-vs-consultant.html): Project consulting and ongoing fractional leadership solve different problems. How to tell which one your operation actually needs — including when it's neither.
- [How to Price Catering Jobs for Profit](https://trecoleman.com/blog/how-to-price-catering-jobs.html): The full cost stack behind a catering quote, the break-even formula most operators get backwards, and the margin benchmarks that show which events pay.
- [Menu Engineering Guide for Restaurant Owners](https://trecoleman.com/blog/menu-engineering-guide.html): How to map contribution margin against popularity, find the items quietly costing you money, and redesign your menu around what actually pays.
- [How Much Does a Restaurant Consultant Cost?](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-consultant-cost.html): What restaurant consultants actually charge, how the common pricing models differ, and how to tell whether an engagement will pay for itself.
- [How to Lower Restaurant Labor Cost](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-labor-cost.html): Labor is the fastest-moving cost you control. How to build a schedule from sales patterns instead of habit, and why cutting hours is usually the wrong first move.
- [The Restaurant P&L, Line by Line](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-profit-and-loss.html): A plain-English walk through a restaurant profit and loss statement: what each line means, which ones you control weekly, and the order to read them in.
- [How to Find & Fix Restaurant Profit Leaks](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-profit-leaks.html): Where independent restaurants quietly lose margin — labor, item mix, waste, and cash flow — and the checks that surface each one.
- [Restaurant SOPs: What to Document First](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-sop-templates.html): Most restaurant SOP projects fail because they start by documenting everything. How to pick the few procedures that actually change what happens on a shift.
- [Restaurant Systems That Support Real Growth](https://trecoleman.com/blog/restaurant-systems-for-growth.html): Move past daily firefighting. The SOPs, scheduling structure, and financial tracking that let an operation grow without the owner in the room.
- [How to Scale a Catering Business Profitably](https://trecoleman.com/blog/scaling-a-catering-business.html): More catering volume without pricing, staffing, and logistics systems means more revenue and less profit. Here's the order to build them in.
